name: Farholde Scouting Report
summary: Krom'rosh at Rog'mar wants a sealed report from Farholde. It may hold news of human activity and a growing cultist threat.

sections.title: A Sealed Report
sections.body: At Rog'mar, Krom'rosh receives the report bearing Farholde's sigil. Its contents mention increased patrols to the west and reinforcements against a growing cultist threat. Krom'rosh says you have done well, and the Horde has word of those movements.

faq.answer: Krom'rosh is at Rog'mar and receives the sealed report from Farholde.

faq.q: What is in the Farholde report?
faq.answer: The report mentions increased patrols to the west and reinforcements against a growing cultist threat.
The report is intended for Krom'rosh at Rog'mar.

faq.q: What does the report say about the west?
faq.answer: It mentions increased patrols to the west and reinforcements against a growing cultist threat.

faq.q: What does Krom'rosh think of the humans?
faq.answer: Krom'rosh calls the humans swine who think they own these lands.

attribution: In-game quest text: Farholde Scouting Report
